title: TorusGuard Memory Pattern
description: Schema for distilled security patterns extracted from raw events. Patterns represent recurring fix strategies, vulnerability classes, and project-specific security idioms.

rule_id.description: TorusGuard rule ID this pattern relates to.

fix_strategy.description: The preferred fix approach observed across multiple occurrences.

confidence.description: Pattern confidence (amplified by repeated confirmations, decayed by TTL).

occurrences.description: Number of times this pattern has been observed.

affected_files.description: List of relative file paths where this pattern has been observed.

decay_checkpoint.description: Last timestamp when this pattern's confidence was reconfirmed or decayed.

source_events.description: List of event_ids that contributed to this pattern.
